raw.query: WITH physical AS (SELECT n_images, image_px, mean_ms AS phys_ms FROM collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine = 'aic' AND note ILIKE '%silicon service%' AND image_px = 448 AND is_valid), collected AS (SELECT n_images, image_px, AVG(mean_ms) AS coll_ms FROM collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine = 'vllm' AND image_px = 448 AND is_valid GROUP BY n_images, image_px) SELECT p.n_images, p.phys_ms, c.coll_ms, (c.coll_ms - p.phys_ms) / p.phys_ms * 100 AS pct_diff FROM physical p JOIN collected c ON p.n_images = c.n_images ORDER BY p.n_images
raw.observed: n=[1,4,9,16,17] → |pct_diff|≤5.5%; n=[25,33,36,41,49,57] → pct_diff=+9.4% to +12.5% (vLLM systematically slower) — also vllm_reconcile_check.vision_image_count passed=true ratio=1.000 on measured:vllm_h100_trace
raw.claimed: The collected encoder operator agrees with physical measurement, a matched-engine check validates the composed forward against the serving engine's own vision tower (vLLM).
raw.evidence: collector_encoder_fn physical-vs-vllm at 448px agrees within ~5% for N≤17 (range 1.2%–5.5%) but systematically diverges to +9.4%–+12.5% at N=25–57. The vllm_reconcile_check on measured:vllm_h100_trace validates image counts (vision_image_count ratio=1.000) and passes 12/13 checks, confirming the matched-engine side. The first sub-claim is overclaimed because the agreement is not uniform — vLLM-collected operator is consistently slower at mid-to-high N.
